Expanding at z=1 produces middle tail T=P(U≥3)=6Σ A_i/(1−p_i)^3−6Σ A_i−48∏p_i. After sorting unnormalized weights as r,r+v,r+v+w,r+v+w+z, multiplying 47/144−T by positive 144 S^4 Q yields a degree-16 integer polynomial. Independently regenerated all 955 nonzero coefficients by a fresh arbitrary-precision polynomial map, compared all against the actual 955-row source certificate.tsv; every coefficient exactly agreed and was strictly positive (minimum 47), with explicit positive r^14 v²,r^14 w²,r^14 z² terms. This proves P(U≥3)≤47/144 strict off uniform for the whole continuous simplex. U≥1 is certain; Long left-PGF order yields U≥2 via z↓0; U=4=24∏p_i≤3/32 by AM–GM. The exact uniform PMF (97,97,67,27)/288 sums to one, giving full ordinary stochastic domination.
